content:
santiago: Quick heads up — PR 4123 updates the KMS helper + secret-rotation script. Blocking tomorrow's deploy until we get a security ok.

amanda: can you drop the PR link and TL;DR? I can take a first pass if helpful.

santiago: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4123
santiago: TL;DR: switch from local keystore to KMS envelope encryption, add HSM-aware rotation hook, update secret ref format.

raj: thanks. do we have audit-log events for rotation? need to ensure auditd records key IDs and user that triggered rotate.

santiago: yes, added events in `audit/keys` with fields `key_id` and `initiator`. small snippet:
```
{ "event": "kms.rotate", "key_id": "projX-2026-01", "initiator": "svc/rotator" }
```

chris: CI green on unit/integration. e2e failures were flakes, rerun passed. here's the last run: https://ci.internal/4221

security-bot: Automated checks: policy-scan OK; secret scanning: no plaintext secrets found; k8s-secret-ref warning: found usage of `default` namespace in one helper — see comment.

leo: can we avoid changing secret naming conventions in the same PR? that complicates rollouts.

santiago: I split rename out into a follow up PR but left in one helper for compat. open to revert if you'd prefer.

amanda: I can review the audit event schema + HSM flow. ping me once you've addressed the k8s comment.

raj: I'll do security review after amanda gives thumbs. likely need 2 approvals for HSM changes.

santiago: noted — aiming to have fixes by EOD. is the deploy window still tomorrow 10:00 PST? @chris

chris: yes, unless we need a hotfix. I can hold merge until approvals if @raj asks.

amanda: taking a pass now, will push small nits inline. :thumbsup:

santiago: thanks all — ping me if you want a walkthrough.

chris: fyi I can merge after both approvals and run the migration job: `rotate_kms.py --apply` (will dry-run first).

security-bot: Reminder: Please include `audit_reason` when running rotation in prod. See infra runbook: https://docs.internal/kms/rotation

raj: I'll aim to review within 2 hours. if I'm late, leave a note and @me for final sign-off.

amanda: left comments re: error handling and metrics. not blocking.

santiago: done, addressed comments and pushed commit 3a9f. ping for re-review.

raj: starting review now.

security-bot: CI re-run triggered by push: https://ci.internal/4229

chris: will stand by to merge after approvals. thanks everyone.
